How it started.

The Thunder led 27–26 after one quarter. At the half, tied 59–59.

2 · The difference

Lillard: 25 points, 13 in the third

5 of 6 in the third quarter, 4 threes in all.

3 · How it turned

Tied at the half, won the third 38–21

Lillard and Avdija combined for 49 of 123.

4 · Where it was won

Won it from the three-point line

Threes made 19–8; assists 26–20. Gilgeous-Alexander shot 8 of 22.

5 · Final

Trail Blazers 123, Thunder 103.

From the Thunder’ side: Lost the third quarter 21–38, the stretch that decided it.

What it meant: the Trail Blazers are 8–3, 5th in the West, with 53% top-6 odds now. The Thunder are 8–4, 7th in the West, at 93%.

2 · The play of the game

Lillard from 30.

Damian Lillard's 30-foot 3-pointer with 1.1 seconds left in the third quarter that made it 97-80.
